spec_match.rationale: Calls the real surfaces: requestDevice behind a gesture, gatt.connect, server.addEventListener('maxwritewithoutresponsesizechanged') with e.target identity logging, and the device-level gattserverdisconnected for contrast — exactly the split the PR specifies.

interactive.rationale: Pair and disconnect buttons drive the real API; the event log records target identity and counts per object; prerequisite readouts update from a real getAvailability() call.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises server-object listeners with target introspection and honest degradation; matches.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinct handling for missing API (with exact Linux flag remedies), insecure context, adapter absent, chooser dismissal (NotFoundError as normal), and pre-157 servers lacking addEventListener.

references.rationale: chromestatus link, spec PR, sibling MTU probe, and the hardware-free probe are all cross-linked.

conformance.rationale: The suite's manual live-dispatch assertion names this page as its verification vehicle; the script assertions cover everything checkable without hardware.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Fallback branches runtime-verified on both classes in headless Chromium 141 (API absent: honest support panel, pair disabled, zero console errors; screenshots read). The success path needs real BLE hardware plus a Chrome 157 build — neither exists in this environment — so it is code-reviewed and left honestly unverified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for support probe, listener attach, listener-unavailable fallback, server event with target identity, and pair termination.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; event lines in accent-blue bold on stone (AA); support states bordered and coloured with text redundancy.

accessibility.rationale: aria-live support panel and event log with aria-label, dl readouts, disabled-state management on pair/disconnect, warnings as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow on either class via CDP; Web Bluetooth availability differences are reported per-platform by the page itself, not hidden.

openQuestions.title: Hardware pass on Chrome 157 with a renegotiating device
openQuestions.detail: The maxwritewithoutresponsesizechanged event only fires when the link renegotiates MTU. Verify on real hardware (e.g. a nRF52 dev board toggling data-length extension) that the once-attached server listener logs e.target === server: true, and capture the log for the critique.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Live regions for asynchronous event streams; label the log list; keep control disabled-states truthful.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Event log is aria-live=polite with aria-label; pair stays disabled until prerequisites hold and re-enables on disconnect.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit readout grid, scrollable bounded log.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Readout auto-fit minmax(150px,1fr); log max-height with overflow-y and wrapping rows.

summary: The hardware path for server-level listening, patterned on the sibling MTU probe. Fallbacks verified for real in this environment; the event-dispatch success path is recorded as the open hardware task.
